title: Wallet hijack: one code puts your card on a stranger's phone
format: Threat story, HSERIA + CTA, second person, rule book v8 (format A), no face beats
voice: Kokoro af_heart (voice B), slower presets for #15 (short words read fast)

lines.text: Your card just jumped onto a stranger's phone.
lines.spoken: Your card just jumped onto a stranger's phone.

lines.text: But it's still in your pocket.
lines.spoken: But it's still in your pocket.

lines.text: One code. That's all it took.
lines.spoken: One code. That's all it took.

lines.text: It starts with a text: a Black Friday deal. 70% off.
lines.spoken: It starts with a text: a Black Friday deal. Seventy percent off.

lines.text: You tap the link and type in your card.
lines.spoken: You tap the link and type in your card.

lines.text: At that same moment, a scammer types it into a wallet on their phone.
lines.spoken: At that same moment, a scammer types it into a wallet on their phone.

lines.text: Your bank isn't sure it's you, so it texts you a code.
lines.spoken: Your bank isn't sure it's you, so it texts you a code.

lines.text: The page asks for it. Or a fake fraud team calls and asks you to read it out.
lines.spoken: The page asks for it. Or a fake fraud team calls and asks you to read it out.

lines.text: You hand it over... and your card goes live on their phone.
lines.spoken: You hand it over... and your card goes live, on their phone.

lines.text: Now they tap to pay, in shops and online.
lines.spoken: Now they tap to pay, in shops and online.

lines.text: One man lost over £18,000 in a few hours.
lines.spoken: One man lost over eighteen thousand pounds, in a few hours.

lines.text: Here's your shield. Read the whole text.
lines.spoken: Here's your shield. Read the whole text.

lines.text: If it mentions adding a card to a wallet and that's not you? Stop.
lines.spoken: If it mentions adding a card to a wallet and that's not you? Stop.

lines.text: No real bank will ever ask you for that code.
lines.spoken: No real bank will ever ask you for that code.

lines.text: Got an alert that a card was added? Call the number on your card.
lines.spoken: Got an alert that a card was added? Call the number on your card.

lines.text: Your bank can switch off their copy.
lines.spoken: Your bank can switch off their copy.

lines.text: Would you have read the code out? Tell me below.
lines.spoken: Would you have read the code out? Tell me below.

lines.text: Send this to anyone shopping this Black Friday.
